title: AgentArcade
tagline: Agent Arcade is a no code AI agent playground to create hundreds and thousands of agents on any chain effortlessly.
description:
Agent Arcade is a no-code platform that empowers users to create and deploy AI agents without writing a single line of code. Whether it’s a social agent, AI companion, DeFi agent, or gaming agent, Agent Arcade allows anyone to build and customize their agents effortlessly. These agents can be deployed on any blockchain, including Flow, Arbitrum, and more, making them truly decentralized and scalable.

Agent Arcade is built using cutting-edge tools like Coinbase Agent Kit, Covalent Agent Kit, and Eliza OS, which ensures seamless interaction with on-chain data, enhanced conversational capabilities, and integration with decentralized protocols. The platform provides a simple interface to define agent behavior, connect them to various data sources, and deploy them in seconds.

The Problem:
AI agents have immense potential in Web3, from automating DeFi strategies to creating interactive gaming experiences and personalized AI companions. However, developing such agents is often restricted to skilled developers with a deep understanding of blockchain technology, smart contracts, and AI frameworks. This creates a significant barrier for non-technical users and slows down the adoption of AI agents in decentralized applications.

Additionally, existing tools are fragmented, requiring users to juggle multiple frameworks and development environments, making it complex and time-consuming to build and deploy agents.

The Solution – Agent Arcade:
Agent Arcade simplifies the entire process by offering a no-code solution that democratizes access to AI agent creation.

No technical knowledge required: Anyone can create powerful agents in minutes.
Multi-chain deployment: Supports deployment on chains like Flow and Arbitrum for maximum flexibility.
Integration-ready: Leverages Coinbase Agent Kit and Covalent Agent Kit for real-time on-chain data interaction.
Versatile agents: From finance to social interactions and gaming, the possibilities are endless.
how_its_made:
Agent Arcade is designed with a modular architecture, using Docker containers to isolate and manage each AI agent. Each agent runs in its own container, allowing for efficient resource management and easy configuration. These containers act can be controlled via HTTP requests,
where details for each unique user such as their wallet details are generated in backend and sent to the containers via http request.

When a user creates an agent, the platform spins up a Docker container specifically for that agent using Dockerode SDK which is a wrapper around Docker API. The user can configure essential details such as the private key, network (Flow, Arbitrum, Ethereum, etc.), and agent behavior via an HTTP API. The container processes the request, interacts with external SDKs or blockchain networks, and returns the result to the backend. The backend then sends the response to the frontend in real-time, creating a seamless experience for the user.

Key Technologies and Tools:
Flow Blockchain: Supports multi-chain deployment, enabling agents to interact with decentralized applications on Flow for DeFi and gaming use cases.

Arbirum Nova Blockchain: Supports multi-chain deployment, enabling agents to interact with decentralized applications on Flow for DeFi and gaming use cases.

Coinbase Agent Kit: Provides secure wallet integration and agent-based transaction management for DeFi and crypto interactions.

Covalent Agent Kit: Allows agents to access real-time on-chain data for analytics and decision-making.

Eliza OS: Enhances the conversational abilities of social agents and AI companions.

Docker: Used to containerize each agent, ensuring scalability, flexibility, and isolation.

Backend and Frontend: The backend orchestrates the agent interactions and processes user requests, while the frontend provides an intuitive no-code interface for users to create and customize their agents.
